en: Heh! That ain't gonna stop us!
It's true that you're all quite strong.{SAUT}You even have the power to resist me.{PAGE}However, expecting such strength from{SAUT}every person is nothing but arrogance...
What do you mean by that?
It's quite easy to say aloud, "Stand up{SAUT}for yourselves."{PAGE}However, actually expecting everyone{SAUT}to be as strong and brave as yourselves?
Are you trying to tell us we're wrong{SAUT}for wanting to help these people?

I understand that you are doing your{SAUT}best to change the hearts of those{SAUT}in the theaters...{PAGE}But is that truly what they desire?{PAGE}Look for yourselves―these are the true{SAUT}feelings of the feeble creatures called{SAUT}"human beings"...
